<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
R=C=11
g=[]
for i in range(R):
    row=''
    for j in range(C):
        vals={rows[15+3*i+di][15+3*j+dj] for di in range(3) for dj in range(3)}
        row += vals.pop() if len(vals)==1 else '?'
    g.append(row)
def bfs(walls):
    def passable(i,j):
        return 0<=i<R and 0<=j<C and g[i][j] not in walls
    s,e=(0,0),(10,10)
    q=deque([s]); prev={s:None}
    while q:
        cur=q.popleft()
        if cur==e: break
        i,j=cur
        for di,dj in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
            n=(i+di,j+dj)
            if n not in prev and passable(*n): prev[n]=cur; q.append(n)
    if e not in prev: return None
    path=[]; cur=e
    while prev[cur] is not None:
        p=prev[cur]; path.append((cur[0]-p[0],cur[1]-p[1])); cur=p
    path.reverse()
    d={(-1,0):'UP',(1,0):'DOWN',(0,-1):'LEFT',(0,1):'RIGHT'}
    return [d[x] for x in path]
p=bfs(['W'])
print('full path', p)
# trace cells
cur=(0,0); cells=[cur]
for a in p:
    di,dj={'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}[a]
    cur=(cur[0]+di,cur[1]+dj); cells.append(cur)
print('cells', cells)
# probe first step
res=action(['DOWN'])
import json
print('res', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')})
def bbox(n):
    rs=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]; cs=[q[1] for q in n['boundary']]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
blue=[n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='b'][0]
print('blue now', bbox(blue))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
